Chunk names must be unique. Each dep is the name of a chunk that this chunk depends on. Chunks must be listed in dependency order, and JS source files must be listed in the corresponding order. Where --chunk flags occur in relation to --js flags is unimportant. <num-js-files> may be set to 'auto' for the first chunk if it has no dependencies. Provide the value 'auto' to trigger chunk creation from CommonJS modules.
